Generate survival dates from their anchor dates

Source: R/mock_spec_survival.R
generate_survival_dates.Rd

Computes each type = "survival" variable in spec from its anchor column in data: floor(n * event_prop) rows receive a date a follow-up time after the anchor (whole days, within [followup_min, followup_max]), and the rest are NA. Variables are processed in dependency order; each is drawn and then has its rules applied: a date earlier than its anchor becomes NA, and, if censored_by is set, a date later than the censoring date becomes NA. Draws use the isolated survival sub-stream of the seed contract.

Usage

generate_survival_dates(data, spec, seed = NULL)

Arguments

data

Data frame of generated baseline values (from generate_mock_data_native() or generate_mock_data_simstudy()), containing each anchor column as class Date.

spec

A mock_spec. Strict-validated at entry.

seed

Optional whole-number seed. The caller's RNG state and kind are restored on exit.

Value

data with one appended Date column per survival variable. Returns data unchanged if the spec has no survival variables.

Details

Survival dates describe true values. postprocess_mock_data() applies missing codes and garbage afterwards, independently for each column.

See also

mock_spec_survival(), evaluate_mock_formulas(), postprocess_mock_data()

Other mock generation APIs: create_mock_data(), generate_mock_data_native(), generate_mock_data_simstudy(), postprocess_mock_data()

Examples

spec <- mock_spec(
  mock_spec_date("entry", range = as.Date(c("2001-01-01", "2005-12-31"))),
  mock_spec_survival("death", anchor = "entry",
    followup_min = 365, followup_max = 7300, event_prop = 0.2)
)
baseline <- generate_mock_data_native(spec, n = 10, seed = 1)
generate_survival_dates(baseline, spec, seed = 1)
#>         entry      death
#> 1  2004-10-26       <NA>
#> 2  2004-10-14 2009-01-17
#> 3  2001-09-28       <NA>
#> 4  2004-04-09       <NA>
#> 5  2003-04-21       <NA>
#> 6  2004-12-21       <NA>
#> 7  2002-10-18       <NA>
#> 8  2005-12-14       <NA>
#> 9  2005-06-09 2011-02-24
#> 10 2001-02-16       <NA>
